summary.objective: Sell a portable blender through a relatable busy-morning problem and quick demo sequence.
summary.target_audience: Busy women aged 22-35 who want faster wellness routines.
summary.creative_strategy: Open with a real morning pain point, show one clear product demo, then close with a natural creator CTA.

structure.goal: Stop scroll with a familiar rushed-morning problem.
structure.content: Creator shows breakfast chaos and says she has no time.

structure.goal: Show the product as a simple solution.
structure.content: Product reveal, fruit loading, one-button blending, and portability moment.

structure.goal: Convert interest into a product click.
structure.content: Creator drinks, shows the product clearly, and gives a natural CTA.

shots.scene_purpose: Stop scroll with relatable pain point.
shots.visual_description: Creator in a bright kitchen looks rushed while holding a banana and gym bag.
shots.subject_action: Creator glances at the counter and then to camera.
shots.dialogue_vo: 没时间做早餐？我现在连奶昔都是出门路上现打。
shots.production_notes: Keep movement natural and product teaser visible on counter.
shots.prompt_hint: Bright kitchen UGC shot, rushed creator, banana, gym bag, vertical framing.

shots.scene_purpose: Reveal product and demonstrate one-button use.
shots.visual_description: Close-up of the white portable blender as fruit and milk are added, then the button is pressed.
shots.subject_action: Hand adds fruit and presses the button.
shots.dialogue_vo: 把水果切好丢进去，按一下就行。
shots.production_notes: Do not claim hard ice crushing; keep product shape consistent.
shots.prompt_hint: White portable blender close-up, fruit and milk added, clean kitchen counter.

shots.scene_purpose: Show the finished drink and portable carry moment.
shots.visual_description: Creator twists the blender cup off the base, snaps on the travel lid, and puts it into a gym bag side pocket.
shots.subject_action: Hand removes the blender cup, adds lid, and packs it into the bag.
shots.dialogue_vo: 打完直接换盖就能带走，早上不用多洗一个杯子。
shots.production_notes: Show the cup and lid clearly; keep the gym bag from covering the product.
shots.prompt_hint: Portable blender cup with travel lid, gym bag side pocket, fast UGC detail shot.

shots.scene_purpose: Connect lifestyle payoff to purchase action.
shots.visual_description: Creator drinks from the blender outside the gym, then holds it near camera.
shots.subject_action: Creator smiles, drinks, and presents the product.
shots.dialogue_vo: 如果你也总是赶时间但又想吃得健康一点，这个真的可以看看。
shots.on_screen_text: 赶时间又想吃得健康一点，可以看看
shots.prompt_hint: Selfie UGC outside gym, creator holding white portable blender clearly.

rhythm_notes: Hook must land in the first 2 seconds.
Demo shots should use fast, readable cuts.
CTA should feel like creator recommendation, not a hard-sell ad.
production_notes: Maintain the same white blender shape across all shots.
Use vertical 9:16 framing with space for subtitles.
Avoid medical, detox, or weight-loss claims.
compliance_notes: Do not imply unsupported ice-crushing performance.
